messages:
Sam (CS): FYI were seeing 401 auth failures for three onboarding customers using Dedicated pools during evals: GridMetrics, PaperTrail, ClariDocs. Opening triage.
Ivy (CS): Ugh. Need a short status note and a special note for two at renewal risk (GridMetrics, ClariDocs).
Ethan (Eng): Root cause: secret-rotation created a new KMS alias; some pool controllers missed the update due to a rollout race. Triage INF-7922.
SupportBot: INF-7922 created by ethan. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-7922 status: investigating.
Sam (CS): OK draft for general affected (1-2 sentences): "Hi we're investigating authentication (401) errors affecting Dedicated pools during onboarding. Engineers found a secret rotation mismatch and are deploying a fix; we'll follow up within 45 minutes and can provide an interim scoped key if needed. Apologies for the disruption."
Rosa (AE): For renewal-risk add: "We value your evaluation; we can provision an interim scoped key or roll back your prior key and offer a one-month credit plus dedicated engineering time to assist cutover."
Maya (Onboarding): Workaround: Ops can create ephemeral scoped keys: `rwctl keys create --scope pool:<POOL_ID> --ttl 2h --label temp`.
InfraOps: We'll generate keys once CS shares pool IDs. Patch rollout started; ETA ~30min.
Sam (CS): Pool IDs sent via DM. Posting comms now and adding a 1-question feedback: "Did this materially affect your decision to proceed? Yes/No" for AE quant.
Ethan (Eng): Patch finished at 2026-03-23T11:12:05Z. Validated pools: pool-2f4, pool-8b1, pool-a9c. Running 20m sampling.
SupportBot: INF-7922 resolved by ethan. RCA: rollout race left controllers with stale secrets. Actions: add rollout gate for secret-rotate, extra monitoring on key-mismatch errors, and CS incident template update.
Sam (CS): I'll send RCA + credit offer to renewal-risk accounts and log follow-ups in INF-7922 and CS risk tracker. If any customer replies escalate, tag me and Rosa.
Ivy (CS): Uploaded final comms: https://drive.redwood.com/cs/onboarding/1918000001-dedicated-auth-comm.md
Rosa (AE): I'll record credit in finance tracker.
Sam (CS): Closing thread, will reopen if customers respond. :thumbsup:
